text_block_list.text:
One day, after concluding my three-year 
journey alongside <chrname>— Heading to the academy 
as usual, I was met with...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-kun! Diligent as 
always, I see.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> is waiting as well. We request your best 
guidance today as well.

Without understanding what was going on, I 
headed to the track. There, alongside <chrname>, 
stood Haiseiko as well—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
My next race... the "Japanese Derby"! I 
absolutely, unconditionally cannot lose!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
All my fans are waiting for a strong me. 
The awakening of "Monster-chan"...!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Please train me strictly and thoroughly! I 
promise I won't cry, no matter what!
choice_data_list: The Derby?! What do you mean by training—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. How's our progress on the 
strategy I requested for the "Arima 
Kinen"? Everything is all set on my end.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Don't sweat it—if three tries don't cut 
it, we just challenge it a fourth time! 
And if that fails, we go for a fifth.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—All is well as long as we win in the end! 
Life is long, so let's whistle a tune and 
advance leisurely!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
My only objective is the Triple Crown... 
Any training other than what serves that 
purpose is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Life, however short, is made still shorter 
by waste of time.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Stake everything you have on this mission. 
Surely you are prepared to etch our names 
in history.

—At that moment, my eyes snapped open. It 
seemed everything up until now had all 
been a dream. A dream where I was the 
Trainer in charge of the legends...

Previously, when I was invited to their 
gathering... we talked about what it would 
be like if I had been their Trainer during 
their active days.
choice_data_list: (Could that be why I had such a dream...?)

text_block_list.text:
Pondering how strange it was, I headed to 
the academy as usual—

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-kun! Diligent as 
always, I see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm? What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
—No, forgive me. It seems our time to chat 
has run out.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: I came here today to bid you farewell.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
We have fulfilled our duty. From this 
point forward... is a path you must walk 
on your own.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
It is time for each of us to return to our 
respective paths.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
We already said our goodbyes to 
Tazuna-chan and the others. We were 
waiting for you last of all.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Eek, look at the time! I have to get 
going to my meeting!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, Trainer-san! Thank you so, so 
much for everything♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Actually, right now I'm thinking about 
holding a joint festival with the girls 
from Tracen Academy... Doesn't that sound 
super exciting?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
If it happens, please be sure to come 
visit! Well then, goodbye for now♪

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
As for me, once again... I shall 
strengthen my support for the racing 
world.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
At the same time... I believe I shall 
occasionally leave my hometown to give 
lectures and such. It appears my words can 
still be of some use, after all.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
If you ever visit Iwate, do let me know. 
Cheerio!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It seems the time spent here has become 
something truly irreplaceable for them... 
leading into their future.
choice_data_list: Was it the same for you as well?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Interacting with the younger 
generation has been tremendously 
stimulating for me too.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I shall make our support for overseas 
campaigns even more robust than it is now. 
As soon as I get back, I will set up a 
meeting.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I might even have to ask for your opinion 
on a few things.
choice_data_list: Yes, you can count on me!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Yes. —Those are good eyes!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I am proud to have stood alongside you as 
a colleague.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Well, it is time. This old-timer shall 
take her leave.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I leave the Twinkle Series... and 
the future beyond it... in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
As long as dreams shine bright, we shall 
meet again somewhere. —Farewell!

Standing side-by-side with <chrname>, who had been 
watching on, I see them off— with the 
resolve to follow in their great 
hoofprints.
